sara: Kicking off US‑East handoff for 18:00-02:00 UTC. I'm primary for the window. Quick checklist: any active incidents, known coverage gaps, or planned maintenance that overlaps?

incident-bot: [AUTO] Active incidents summary 
- 3923451234 (P1): embeddings latency spike, started 2026-03-14T17:42:10Z. Affected customers: ~3% of API calls, latency up ~2-5s. Current assignee: tony.

tony: I'm on the embeddings P1, staying on until we stabilize. ETA ~30m for first mitigation (hotfix routing). I'll monitor but need to sleep later so will hand off after 19:15 UTC if not resolved.

maria: I'll be secondary for the shift. Heads up I have a 22:00 UTC standing call — I can take pager if it's high-severity but might be slow in that 22:00-22:30 window. Will set phone alerts.

sara: thanks. sylvia, you still covering APAC fallback tonight?

sylvia: yes. I'll be available except 00:30-01:00 UTC for a quick window. If something spikes in APAC route to eu-fallback and ping me.

kevin: small clarification on escalation rules for handoffs — posting condensed runbook below so we have the exact steps in-channel.

kevin: Escalation matrix (short):
- P0 (service down / customer-facing outage): page primary + SRE lead immediately, open #inc-bridge, notify CS oncall, and DM execs list. If no ack from primary in 2m -> page SRE lead again and escalate to oncall manager.
- P1 (degraded with customer impact): page primary. If no ack in 5m -> page secondary + post brief to #status (1-line impact). After 15m -> escalate to SRE lead.
- P2 (internal degradation): create ticket, assign default owner, monitor. Page only if degradation grows or user-visible.

kevin: Example paging commands we use: `pagerduty trigger --service "redwood-inference" --severity critical --summary "P0 - API down"` or Slack: `/page @oncall primary` (our alias).

sara: Adding a short, copyable triage snippet for runbook steps for embeddings latency (put in runbook too):
```
1) Check hot routes: curl -s https://metrics.redwood/api/embeddings?window=5m | jq '.p50,.p95'
2) If p95 > 2s -> switch to fallback model pool: infra route set embeddings pool=low-latency-fallback
3) If traffic > 2x baseline -> enable rate limiting for anon clients: config throttle anon_rps=5
4) Notify CS with impact template and include request IDs
5) If no improvement in 15m -> escalate to SRE lead and open bridge
```

tony: copied. I'm going to try a routing change now (will post curl + result). If it fails I need someone to page Alex (infra lead) — Alex's PD schedule is listed in the org chart.

maria: i'll takeover if tony needs to hand off. If Alex doesn't ack within 7m, follow escalation below: page secondary -> if still no ack in 10m -> page SRE lead -> open bridge.

alex: fyi i'll be reachable by phone until 20:30 UTC, but heads up I'm in a deployment window from 21:00-21:20 — try to avoid critical infra changes then. If you page and I don't respond, assume hands-off and escalate to kevin.

kevin: small procedural note — during handoff always do two things: 1) confirm active incidents and current assignees; 2) leave a one-line status in the runbook header with timestamp and next expected action. Example header line: `Handoff 2026-03-14 18:00 UTC | primary=sara | active=embeddings(P1, tony) | next=tony routing attempt`

sara: noted. I'm adding that header now to the embeddings runbook at https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-latency (please update when you change ownership).

maria: small ask — can we shorten primary ack window to 3m for P0s? We've had cases where 5m was too long at peak.

kevin: we can make it 3m for P0. P1 stays 5m, escalate to secondary at 5m as before. I'll update the team doc and incident-bot config.

incident-bot: [AUTO] Acknowledgement policy updated: P0 ack window = 3m, P1 ack window = 5m. Changes applied to incident-bot ruleset by kevin.

sara: last thing — coverage gap notes: maria 22:00-22:30, sylvia 00:30-01:00; tony expects to hand off ~19:15 if embeddings not resolved. If overlap causes primary gap, we agreed on this fallback chain: secondary -> Alex (infra) -> kevin (SRE lead).

tony: doing the routing flip now, will post result in 2m. If you don't hear from me after 5m, assume no ack and page Alex.

sara: thanks team. I'll stay on the channel until 19:30 for warm handoff with tony. I'll DM maria when I step out for any brief phone-needed windows. :thumbsup:
